checks.validation: Account, network, metadata or risk context changed; review again
Margin or fee estimate increased; review again

policy: Same exact executable payload, owner/network/market metadata/configuration, account state and funding context. Refresh mark/capacity and enforce exact size/notional. A higher margin or fee estimate always requires fresh review; the original 15-second expiry remains. All signatures/transactions require their own user decisions.
limitations: These bounded eth_call diagnostics themselves sign/send nothing
Margin/fee checks are pre-sign checks, not contract-enforced ceilings or liquidation protection
Full account context remains private; actual root execution has separate evidence
